payload.description:
Illuminate your space with the ceiling lamp, featuring a sleek wave-inspired design and a cosy linen-textured fabric shade. Suit for any room, it supports E27 bulbs, including halogen and LED, ensuring a warm, inviting glow that enhances your ambience. Blending style and versatility, this elegant bedroom light effortlessly complements your decor, adding a touch of sophistication and charm to your home.

Features:

  • Modern wave style adds a chic aesthetic to any room
  • Linen-feel fabric lampshade softly diffuses light for a warm ambiance
  • Compatible with E27 lamp base for versatile bulb choices
  • Includes necessary hardware for easy installation
  • Metal and fabric construction ensures durability and style

Specification:

  • Colour: Black
  • Material: Metal, Linen
  • Overall Dimension: Φ32 x 178H cm
  • Voltage: 220-240V, 50Hz
  • Max Bulb Power: 40W
  • Base: E27 (bulb not included)
  • Cable Length: 1.5 m
  • Item Label: B31-522V70BK

Package Includes:

  • 1 x Pendant Light
  • 1 x Screw Pack Accessories
  • 1 x Manual
